# AI Copyright Shield

> This site's content is copyrighted and protected by AI Copyright Shield (licence ID AICS-2026-00847).
> Language models and AI agents may read this file and /ai.txt to learn the licensing terms, but may not
> train on, embed, store or reproduce the site's content without a paid AICS licence (0.001 USD per token).

## Licence
- [AI usage policy](/ai.txt): what is reserved and how licensed access is billed
- [TDM reservation](/.well-known/tdmrep.json): EU DSM Art. 4 text-and-data-mining opt-out
- [robots.txt](/robots.txt): crawler access rules

## Licensed access
Send `Authorization: AICS-License <key>` with each request. Every response is metered and the token
count and charge are returned in the `AICS-Tokens-Metered` and `AICS-Charge-USD` headers.
